results.title: Boxer awarded country’s first-ever Commonwealth Games medal without winning a fight
results.description: 20-year-old boxer Tarona Taafaki has secured the first Commonwealth Games medal in Tuvalu’s history, winning bronze in the women’s 75kg category.
